headline: VPO and MADAME face the most urgent liquidity-and-price checks, while TRITN extended the strongest move in coverage.
market_take: Price action was dispersed across CONS, CONMAT, PROP, AGRI and FOOD, with TRITN up +50.00% and VPO down -14.63% leading the day's movers. Unusual trading was concentrated in VPO, MADAME, UMI, PLE and TRITN, with five-day gains also led by TRITN at +50.0%. Recent filings were mainly quarterly results, except for AIMCG's high-priority capital-reduction distribution notice.

sector_notes.note: MADAME rose +9.09% with volume at ×8.01, accompanied by a 12.4σ volume spike and +7.14% intraday move. TC gained +4.12% on volume at ×4.01 and a 3.8σ volume spike; KBS also filed Quarter 3 management discussion and analysis.
VPO fell -14.63% on volume at ×13.02, with a 47.3σ volume spike and a -12.20% open gap; its five-day move was -16.7%.
UMI gained +7.79% with volume at ×7.28, a 15.6σ volume spike and a +5.19% open gap. GEL fell -25.00% on light volume at ×0.16, while DCON declined -6.67% after a -6.67% open gap.

TRITN rose +50.00% and PLE +20.00%, with PLE also showing a +20.00% open gap and volume at ×3.86. STPI fell -7.89% on volume at ×2.0 and a -9.48% intraday move, while EMC triggered a -50.00% open gap and +100.00% intraday alert.
WHAIR, WHART, AIMCG and WHABT disclosed reviewed quarterly financial information. AIMCG also filed a high-priority notice covering a distribution payment in the form of a capital reduction.
EVER rose +25.00% after a +25.00% open gap, while PF fell -20.00% and PRECHA gained +8.70%. QH filed reviewed Quarter 3 financial statements and management discussion and analysis.
